integrity: All claims have an accompanying analytic proof and a standalone supplementary checker. Earlier general results are attributed. No external independent mathematical evaluation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Fixed generalized-Aluthge exponent and exponential damping on a specific affine monomial family. The general single-step weighted-composition formula is prior art. Full-text comparisons with 2009 weighted translation iterations were unavailable; unindexed exact equivalents are a residual risk. Finite arithmetic tests do not prove infinite-dimensional spectral statements.
title: Unitarily rigid Aluthge orbits with opposite strong limits for affine monomial operators
